text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely having omurice today! I've 
had my mind set on it since yesterday~.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll go with~... Wait, was this ramen 
always on the menu?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
That's a brand new item~! Hardly anyone's 
ordered it yet, though... Care to give it 
a try, girls?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really? Even though it looks so 
delicious...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Actually, I'll take the ramen! 
It's important to try new things once in a 
while, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ahh, totally stuffed!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~... My belly is so full. Uuuu, I 
can't move an inch—

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu~, wanna play volleyball? We're 
short on players for a team match~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that so! ...Um, errr...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a little post-meal exercise could be 
good... I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: See ya tomorrow then, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, catch ya later.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna run a ton today~. After 
all—

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu, Dantsu~! Did you hear?! The milk 
pudding parfait is back on the menu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Eh! ...Ehhh!? You mean the one from the 
shop by the station...!?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that one! You went there like crazy 
last year, right? Let's go together right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah~! Thanks for letting me know! Man, I 
really want to...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: But—sorry, maybe next time!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I really want to run today. I want to show 
solid results in the next mock race.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Horseshoes checked, course checked. All 
that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A running partner, and that's checked too! 
...Right!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Pokke-chan! Huh, what brings you here...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No reason in particular! Just felt like 
running with ya a bit. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after school. I spotted the two of 
them training. ...From the dirt smudges, 
it was clear how hard they worked.
choice_data_list: Keep up the good work on self-training.
Don't forget to take proper breaks!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Pokke-chan helped me out too, so... I 
really want to win. Definitely.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Next time, let's duke it out on the 
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...Wait, look at the time!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's go grab some food and hit the sack~. 
You'd better eat that omurice this time, 
got it?
